messages:
sam_ops: FYI: scheduled model rollout tonight 22:00-22:45 UTC for a minor tokenization fix. This is hosted-only; Dedicated deployments will be pinned for the window. Need a short status-page blurb + customer email. Canary plan: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 15m -> 100% if all good.

jules_prod: I can draft the status entry. Do we have explicit rollback criteria? Also want to call out embeddings/long-context endpoints may see transient effects.

anita_eng: Rollback triggers: sustained latency +25% vs baseline for 10 minutes OR error rate >0.8% for 10 minutes. Dedicated clusters are pinned to v3.2.4 during the maintenance window; hosted gets staged rollout.

matt_release: Release checklist: 
• CI smoke pass ✅
• canary infra configured ✅
• observability dashboard: https://internal.redwood/obs/model-rollout-22
• runbook owners: @anita_eng (primary), @matt_release (backup)

DeployBot: rollout scheduled by @matt_release for 22:00 UTC. Canary groups: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Logs streaming to #eng-oncall.

jules_prod: Proposed status blurb (short):
```
Status: Planned maintenance
When: 22:00 — 22:45 UTC
Impact: Short-term degradation possible for hosted generation and embeddings during a staged model update. Dedicated deployments will be pinned to the previous model for the maintenance window.
What we're doing: Staged canary rollout with automated rollback if performance regresses. Updates will be posted here and on the status page.
```

emma_cs: Good start. Please add that customers with strict SLAs can request a pause and include a contact link.

jules_prod: Updated blurb + concise rollback criteria for the status page: 
```
Rollback criteria: latency +25% sustained for 10 minutes OR error rate >0.8% sustained for 10 minutes -> immediate rollback to prior model.
Contact: support@redwood.ai
```

anita_eng: Ops notes: enable verbose request tracing for the first 15 minutes and retain extended logs (48h) for affected models. Adjusted throttling thresholds to avoid noisy spikes.

matt_release: Timing plan: publish status page at 21:30 (30m prior), send customer email at 21:35, start rollout at 22:00. I'll enable extra logging and create an incident timeline stub for quick updates.

DeployBot: Canary stage 1 live at 22:00:00 UTC (5%). Monitoring hook active.

anita_eng: t+8m: transient latency +9%, error rate 0.1% — within thresholds, continuing rollout.

matt_release: Promoting to 25% at t+12m. No rollback triggered.

DeployBot: Full rollout completed at 22:26:14 UTC. No automatic rollback applied.

sam_ops: Nice work. Observed a brief latency blip during early canary — assigned perf-investigations to follow up. @jules_prod please close status update after 1h with summary.

jules_prod: Will post final resolved update at 23:30 UTC with a short timeline and notes.

emma_cs: Customers notified; a couple of Dedicated teams used the opt-out link and we are coordinating individually.

matt_release: Closing notes: rollout completed smoothly. Opened follow-up ticket for perf-team and adding a tokenization edge-case test to CI.

jules_prod: Final status message (to be posted):
```
Status: Resolved
Summary: Staged model update completed without incident. We observed a short-lived latency increase during canary which did not trigger rollback. Dedicated customers remained on the prior version during the window. Follow-up: performance investigation opened.
```
